Conscious adult patients: ≥ 18 years of age
  2

left.raw_text:
Moderate to severe pain associated with trauma (NRS0-10 ≥ 4) which is unlikely to require surgery/hospitalization, such as
       -  Musculoskeletal injuries  [OR] and physical wounds
       -  Fractures
       -  Lacerations
       -  Burns
       -  Dislocations
       -  Contusions
       -  Injury due to foreign bodies
  3

right.raw_text:
Patient (and/or patient's authorized legal representative) should understand the nature of the study and provide written informed consent
  4

left.raw_text:
Patient is able to follow all study requirements and procedures and complete required questionnaires
Exclusion Criteria:
  1

Women  [AND] of child bearing potential  [AND] who are pregnant  [OR] or peri partum, including labour
  3

An altered level of consciousness, due to any cause, including head injury, [OR]  drugs, [OR]  or alcohol
  4

A history of liver dysfunction after previous MEOF  [OR] use or other halogenated anesthetics
  6

right.raw_text:
Hypersensitivity to MEOF  [OR] or other halogenated anesthetics, [OR]  or to butylated hydroxytoluene
  7

left.raw_text:
Known or genetically susceptible to malignant hyperthermia  [OR] or a history of severe adverse reactions in either patient  [OR] or relatives
  8

Clinically evident  [OR] or potential hemodynamic instability as per the opinion of the investigator
 10

Clinically evident respiratory impairment as per the opinion of the investigator
 11
